config:
hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description LAN side
 ip address 10.10.0.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group EDGE-IN in
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list extended EDGE-IN
 remark Allow web and DNS, block RDP
 permit tcp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 host 203.0.113.10 eq 443
 permit tcp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 host 203.0.113.10 eq 80
 permit udp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 host 198.51.100.53 eq domain
 permit tcp any any established
 deny tcp any any eq 3389
 permit tcp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 any range 8000 8080
 permit tcp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 any gt 1023
 deny ip any any log
!

hostname router1
!
ip access-list extended PROBE2
 10 permit icmp any any
 20 permit tcp host 192.168.1.5 eq 123 host 192.168.2.5
 30 permit udp any any lt 512
 40 deny ip any any
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 ip address 192.168.7.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group MGMT-ONLY out
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list standard MGMT-ONLY
 permit 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
 permit host 192.168.1.50
 deny any
!

hostname router1
!
ip access-list standard 24
 permit 172.16.0.0 0.0.255.255
 deny any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 172.16.1.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group 24 in
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
ip access-list extended 101
 permit tcp any any eq 22
 deny ip any any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.2 255.255.255.252
 ip access-group 101 in
 no shutdown
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list standard NAT-SRC
 permit 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255
!
ip nat inside source list NAT-SRC interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0 overload
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list standard 10
 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
!
ip nat pool PUBPOOL 198.51.100.16 198.51.100.31 netmask 255.255.255.0
ip nat inside source list 10 pool PUBPOOL
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.0.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list extended INSIDE-NETS
 permit ip 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255 any
!
ip nat pool PATPOOL 203.0.113.32 203.0.113.47 netmask 255.255.255.240
ip nat inside source list INSIDE-NETS pool PATPOOL overload
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.5.5.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip nat inside source static 10.5.5.10 203.0.113.50
ip nat inside source static 10.5.5.11 203.0.113.51
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.6.6.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip nat inside source static tcp 10.6.6.20 80 203.0.113.60 8080 extendable
ip nat inside source static udp 10.6.6.21 53 203.0.113.60 5353 extendable
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 1 ip 10.10.10.1
 standby 1 priority 110
 standby 1 preempt
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 ip address 192.168.30.3 255.255.255.0
 standby version 2
 standby 10 ip 192.168.30.1
 standby 10 priority 105
 standby 10 preempt
 standby 10 timers 1 3
 standby 20 ip 192.168.30.254
 standby 20 priority 95
 no shutdown
!

hostname switch1
!
vlan 100
!
interface Vlan100
 ip address 10.100.0.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 5 ip 10.100.0.1
 standby 5 priority 120
 standby 5 preempt
 standby 5 name CORE-GW
 standby 5 track GigabitEthernet1/0/1 20
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
ip access-list extended PROBE14
 permit tcp any any fragments
 permit udp any any eq 123
 deny ip any any
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.7.7.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip nat inside source static tcp 10.7.7.20 443 203.0.113.61 443
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 172.16.40.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 3 ip 172.16.40.1
 standby 3 priority 90
 standby 3 timers msec 250 msec 750
 no shutdown
!
